mainEntity.name: What factors should I consider when choosing a builder for my landlord-ready tiny home?

acceptedAnswer.text: When selecting a builder, prioritize experience with ADUs and local building codes in San Diego County. Look for a firm with a strong portfolio of completed projects, positive client testimonials, and a clear understanding of the specific requirements for rental properties. Ensure they offer comprehensive services, from design and permitting assistance to construction and final inspection. A builder who communicates clearly and provides transparent pricing and timelines will ensure a smoother project.
acceptedAnswer.description: Choose a builder with ADU experience, local code knowledge, strong portfolio, client testimonials, comprehensive services, and clear communication for your tiny home project.
